name: dev.footballapi/football-soccer-live-scores-stats-odds-mcp
title: FootballAPI — Live Soccer Scores, Fixtures, xG & Odds MCP
description: Live football and soccer scores, fixtures, league standings, lineups, player stats, and match odds.

tools.name: get_live_football_matches
tools.description: Retrieve real-time global football scores, match clocks, possession %, shots on target, corners, cards, and Expected Goals (xG) telemetry across Premier League (epl), Champions League (ucl), LaLiga (laliga), Serie A (seriea), Bundesliga (bundesliga), Ligue 1 (ligue1), MLS (mls), or all top leagues. Cost: 2 Credits / match returned (0 Credits if empty).

league.description: League code: epl, ucl, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, mls, eredivisie, libertadores, europa, worldcup, or all.

live_only.description: When true, filters strictly to currently in-play matches.

tools.name: get_football_fixtures
tools.description: Query football matchday schedules, kickoff UTC timestamps, stadium venues, results, and match stats by league and optional date (YYYYMMDD) across 50+ global competitions. Cost: 2 Credits / fixture returned (0 Credits if empty).

league.description: League code: epl, ucl, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, mls, eredivisie, libertadores, or all.

date.description: Optional match date formatted as YYYYMMDD (e.g. "20261107").

tools.name: get_league_standings
tools.description: Fetch live football league standings including rank, played, won, drawn, lost, goals for/against, goal difference, points, points per game, and qualification zones for Premier League, Champions League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, and MLS. Cost: 2 Credits / call.

league.description: League code: epl, ucl, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, mls, eredivisie, libertadores.

tools.name: get_match_detail_and_lineups
tools.description: Retrieve the full tactical match dossier for a specific match_id: starting XI & formations, substitutes, goals/cards/VAR key events, play-by-play commentary, possession %, shots, corners, saves, passes, and Expected Goals (xG). Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits if not found).

match_id.description: Numeric match_id from get_live_football_matches or get_football_fixtures (e.g. "401878758").

league.description: Optional league hint (e.g. epl, ucl, laliga).

tools.name: get_team_roster
tools.description: Retrieve a football club squad roster by team_id (e.g. "359") or club name (e.g. "Arsenal", "Barcelona"), returning jersey numbers, positions, age, height/weight, nationality, appearances, goals, assists, and cards. Cost: 2 Credits / call.

league.description: League code: epl, ucl, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, mls.

team_id.description: Numeric club ID (e.g. "359" for Arsenal) or club name (e.g. "Arsenal", "Chelsea").
